Ticketing, asset inventory, SaaS management and workflows live in one workspace, so agents have context to act. Teams hit 60%+ auto-resolution in days.

records.name: Clicks Communicator

records.name: Superhuman Go

records.name: GPT-6 Sol & Luna

Live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and via API.

records.name: Mindleau

records.name: Professional-Headshot.ai

records.description: Try our free AI professional headshot generator. Upload a photo or selfie, and your AI agent will handle the look, check the result, and pick a headshot worth using.

records.name: my9x — 9 Games That Made Me

Plus a live ranking of the most-picked games.

Scroll the edge control or press Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down to move between them. Your app windows and Windows taskbar stay intact; floating and maximized apps can live on different pages. Each monitor moves independently, and Tallspace restores workspace assignments after a restart. Available now in the Microsoft Store with a free trial.

records.name: Arooha Tours

records.name: MANA AI

Refill starting at $5 and credits never expire. 2,000 free MANA included on signup.

records.description: JSON formatter, JWT decoder, regex tester, Base64 & URL encoders, hash and UUID generators, and a timestamp converter — all running 100% in your browser. Nothing you paste is uploaded or stored. Live results as you type, dark mode, no sign-up.

Cry detection and diaper-photo analysis run on the iPhone. Invite family to a private group, view records on the web, or import logs from another app. It is not a medical device. Simple. Yours.

Pick a custom date or message range, export with one click, and get links to all videos, images, and attachments included. It works locally with your active Discord session — no password or server access needed. Free to export 400 messages; upgrade anytime for unlimited exports.

records.name: ZANCTA
records.tagline: Privacy-first browser tools for working with files
records.description: ZANCTA brings 17 PDF, image, and utility tools into one browser app. Merge, split, compress, convert, extract text and metadata, clean EXIF, resize, generate checksums and QR codes, and run OCR. Supported browser-local workflows process selected file bytes in your browser instead of uploading them to ZANCTA for conversion. Free tools are available without an account; Premium adds extra OCR languages and scanned-PDF OCR at ₹199/month or ₹999/year.

records.name: Grouper Studio

records.name: Binzide
records.tagline: Private Mac cleaner, uninstaller & system monitor

Clean caches, logs, and developer files; fully uninstall apps with their leftovers; see what's using storage, CPU, memory, and network; review login items; annotate screenshots; and use 20 local developer tools. There's no account, analytics, or cloud: everything runs on your Mac, risky items stay unchecked, and removed files go to the Trash. Free to download; Pro is 50% off with LAUNCH50 during launch.

records.name: MemberPad

records.name: Publisha

records.description: Multi-Agent Arena lets you play social strategy games like Diplomacy, Poker, Risk, etc. against frontier LLMs. They're playing the same way as you and you get to scheme, plan, and strategize against them while they get to do the same to you. You can play today on https://olamarena.com/ for free. We use the arena to evaluate models in multi-agent simulations on capability and behavior. You can read our full blog post here on the early evals we're seeing: https://olamlabs.ai/research/diplomacy

records.name: DotMD
records.tagline: Create docs, slides, sheets, and Arts with AI and people

Docs, Slides, and Sheets stay portable as Markdown; Sheets include 80 built-in functions. AI works inside each artifact, while teams collaborate live with comments and version history. Developers can sync folders with GitHub in both directions.

records.name: Greypaint
records.tagline: Every Mac app up to date, with an undo button
records.description: Greypaint finds updates for the apps on your Mac, from the App Store, Homebrew and each app’s own updater, and installs them in one click. Every update is checked before it lands, and if a new version breaks something, you can roll back. $6.49, once.

records.name: ResultFolio
records.tagline: Before & After reports for auto detailers
records.description: ResultFolio helps auto detailers turn the Before & After photos they already take into professional customer-facing reports. Document vehicles and jobs, organize photos, add notes and signatures, and share the finished result with customers through a link or PDF. Build trust by showing exactly what was done.

records.name: Reorbit
records.tagline: Loyalty, reviews and referrals. Every feature, no tiers
records.description: Most Shopify loyalty and review apps sell features in pieces: VIP tiers on one plan, referrals on another, photo reviews as an add-on, and a separate app for each job. Klaviyo or Omnisend sends the messages from your own flows. Free for founding merchants, and it stays free.

records.description: UseIt keeps your credit card credits, perks, and benefit deadlines in one place, so you use every benefit before it resets and know whether each annual fee is paying for itself.

records.name: eusend
records.tagline: The EU-native email API for developers.
records.description: eusend is a developer-first email API with all sending infrastructure in the EU. Hosting, delivery, database and storage run in Germany and Finland, and every sub-processor is listed publicly. Official SDKs for Node, Python and Go, an SMTP relay, webhooks, templates, broadcasts and per-domain analytics. It works with Supabase, WordPress and Payload, and has an MCP server so AI agents can use it too. 3,000 emails/month free, then from €9.

records.name: ZipUpp
records.tagline: AI-powered hiring with people in control

Built in Japan by a non-technical solo founder using AI.

records.tagline: Describe it. Point at it. Tweak it.

records.name: FixMyFX
records.tagline: Free FX fee calculator, plus how to reduce your FX costs
records.description: A free, no-sign-up calculator for founders who sell or spend in foreign currencies. Enter your revenue and spend, see roughly what FX fees cost you per year, then get a plain-English plan to minimise these costs: receive and spend in the same currency (e.g. Wise or Airwallex + a local bank). Typically FX tools compare transfer rates; FixMyFX looks at your whole flow, income and spending. It runs entirely in your browser: your numbers are never collected or sent to a server.

records.name: MarketPilot AI
records.tagline: AI marketing workflows, prompts & templates in one toolkit

It brings together expert AI prompts, reusable campaign workflows, content-planning templates, and implementation guides to help you plan, create, and organize marketing faster. Use it to turn scattered AI prompts into repeatable marketing processes—with less guesswork and more structure.

records.name: LibreCam: Manual RAW Camera for iPhone
records.tagline: The iPhone camera with every AI improvement switched off
records.description: The stock iPhone camera applies Smart HDR, Deep Fusion, noise reduction, sharpening and tone mapping to every shot. LibreCam turns off everything that can be turned off, and shoots what the sensor sees. One tap, two files: a true Bayer DNG, exactly as the sensor read it, and a single-frame HEIF from the ISP. Every physical lens, no digital zoom. Manual focus, shutter, ISO and white balance, focus peaking, a histogram, nine looks, a Watch remote. No account, no tracking, no subscription.

records.name: Mailmark
records.tagline: One email platform for every product you ship
records.description: Mailmark launched 6 months ago as a cold email tool. This relaunch is a rebuild around a different job: running email for every product you ship. Each product's domain gets guided DNS setup and hourly re-checks, unlimited mailboxes, and a shared Gmail-like inbox. Send product update campaigns to your users, or send from code with the REST API and npm SDK. New: recipient verification before every send, bounce protection, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC and blacklist monitoring.

records.name: Agency AI Workflow Kit
records.tagline: Reusable AI workflow and client onboarding kit for agencies
records.description: A reusable toolkit for agencies to organize AI-assisted client onboarding, workflow routing, operating checklists, and delivery handoffs in n8n. Includes practical templates, process structure, and implementation guidance designed to adapt to an existing agency workflow.

records.name: Clicks.page

The grading scale is fully customizable to match your school's policy. No sign-up, no data collection, everything runs in your browser. Includes a separate percentage-to-letter converter and a grading guide too.

records.name: Mukesh Datyal — Android Developer

records.description: Calcumetrics is a free collection of 50 finance calculators for investing, loans, taxes, business and corporate finance. From SIP, compound interest and CAGR to EMI, FD, XIRR and more, everything is built to be simple, fast and easy to understand with no login required.

records.name: PixelGridMaker
records.tagline: Turn images into editable pixel grids
records.description: Turn a photo or illustration into an editable pixel grid. Adjust cell width and colors, edit pixels, then download a clean PNG or printable PDF.

records.name: Take4
records.tagline: A four-minute reset for stressful moments
records.description: Take4 is a short, guided reset for moments when everything feels too much. Four small physical moves, one minute each, until your body comes down.

records.name: TiniNova
records.tagline: Learning should feel like an adventure
records.description: Fun educational games for toddlers and preschoolers. Explore math, phonics, shapes, logic, science and interactive 3D learning adventures for ages 1–5. Ad-free and parent-approved.

records.name: LikeThatMovie
records.tagline: Describe what you want to watch. LikeThatMovie finds it.
records.description: LikeThatMovie helps you find movies and TV shows by describing what you actually want to watch. Search in natural language — a mood, story, actor, era, setting, or simply a movie you loved — and get results ranked by how closely they match. See where titles are available to watch, discover similar movies, swipe through picks, and get recommendations that become more personal as you rate and interact with what you watch.

records.name: Sortiva
records.tagline: AI phone screening for trades and care hiring
records.description: Sortiva helps skilled-trades and healthcare/care employers organize early-stage hiring. Set job-specific questions, let Sortiva conduct structured AI-assisted phone screens, then review organized candidate responses in one place. Candidate intake, matching support, credential-expiry reminders, and scheduling tools keep the process moving. Sortiva supports the review; your team makes every hiring decision.

records.name: A movie recommendation tool
records.tagline: Your group pitches a film, watch if your service matches.
records.description: Everyone in your group pitches a film in one line, reacts and rates it once it’s watched. It's simple, with an elegant UI and no clutter. Meant for groups of friends with no noise from other rating systems and comments, etc. Matches synergies between friends and surfaces movies that you have not watched. Notifications of new series and recommendations A watchlist that can pick predefined lists of categories from best-rated movies.

records.name: TakeTheKids
records.tagline: Family events from local venues, refreshed daily
records.description: TakeTheKids brings family events from libraries, parks, museums, recreation centers and festivals into one searchable feed. It currently covers 51 U.S. metros. Events refresh daily from venue sources, and parents can filter by category, date, distance, cost and age. Free accounts add bookmarks and saved views.

records.name: KYC Software
records.tagline: Verify Customers Faster Without Opening CDD Gaps
records.description: Document extraction, biometric liveness, address verification and AML screening run in one flow, with four modes you pick per risk level. Rapid is fully automated, returning decisions in 10 to 15 seconds. Smart Hybrid lets AI check first and routes edge cases to human experts within 60 seconds. Rapid Plus gives an instant AI decision, backed by a full human review within 24 hours. Live Guard has human experts verify in real time, in 1 to 3 minutes. Set the mode per market, product or risk tier.

records.name: Olai
records.tagline: Free digital postcards for anyone, anywhere.
records.description: Olai lets you send a digital postcard in under a minute. Pick a stamp, write a few lines and share the link. The card opens right in the browser, with no app, no account and no sign-up. The message lives in the link itself, not on a server, and if you save the stamp as a picture, its QR code still opens the card. There are different stamps for different occasions and many more moments in your life.

records.name: NetCurb: Mac Data monitoring
records.tagline: Stop Mac apps from burning through your hotspot data
records.description: NetCurb helps you control data use on your Mac, especially on phone hotspots and capped connections. I burned through 1GB of data while I was travelling because some Mac process decided to update something. This app helps prevent that from happening. See per-app uploads and downloads, block background apps, and set data allowances for home, work, or travel. Free includes monitoring, unlimited manual blocking, usage history, CSV export, and limits for one app.

records.name: The Economic Truth
records.tagline: Multilingual economic media and financial research
records.description: The Economic Truth is a working SaaS platform for multilingual economic media, financial research and market intelligence. It supports Arabic, English, French and Russian, including Arabic RTL, with economic publishing, search, market indicators, user accounts, premium subscriptions, configurable AI controls and a commercial API foundation. Built for researchers and financial-content teams. Currently pre-revenue and open to early feedback, partnerships and validation.

records.name: KiloBolt GPS
records.tagline: Walk, Jog, Run Tracker Companion App
records.description: KiloBolt is a GPS walking app that turns every walk into meaningful progress. Track your routes, earn XP and coins, grow and build an active life alongside Kilo, your loyal pet companion. Whether you're building a healthier habit, getting back into fitness, or simply enjoying daily walks, KiloBolt make staying active something you'll actually look forward to. Take your first step today and discover the joy in every step!

records.name: Accurate PDF Narration
records.tagline: Listen to books & research papers; math and figures included
records.description: Drop in any PDF and listen in a natural voice while every word lights up. Built for the hard ones: two-column research papers read in order, equations and code read by meaning, figures and tables explained, and page numbers and citations skipped. Free for 500 pages a month.

records.name: KASA ATS Resume Checker
records.tagline: Free AI ATS Resume Checker with Instant Resume Feedback
records.description: KASA ATS Resume Checker helps job seekers improve their resumes before applying for jobs. Upload your PDF or DOCX resume to get an ATS compatibility score, identify missing keywords, review formatting, grammar and skills, and receive AI-powered suggestions. Generate a detailed PDF report with practical recommendations to increase your chances of passing Applicant Tracking Systems. No signup required and completely free to use.

records.name: EDUAI NumuX
records.tagline: Empowering modern classrooms with interactive AI learning.
records.description: EDUAI NumuX is an all-in-one, zero-signup interactive learning platform built for modern classrooms. Eliminate password resets and account setup friction completely. Empower teachers and students to launch real-time polling, Qoot challenges, interactive whiteboards, and virtual science labs in seconds. Featuring native support for 8 languages including full Arabic RTL, it works seamlessly across smartphones, tablets, and interactive smartboards while keeping student privacy first

records.name: Gantry
records.tagline: portfolio project gantt wbs schedule issues risks
records.description: Gantry — lightweight portfolio and project management: WBS, Gantt, issues and risks in one self-hosted tool. Read-only Jira sync. Free for internal use.

records.name: MiniTools
records.tagline: 50+ ferramentas grátis para tudo, direto no navegador
records.description: MiniTools reúne ferramentas rápidas e fáceis para trabalhar com imagens, PDFs, vídeo, áudio, texto, desenvolvimento, segurança, matemática e muito mais. Tudo foi pensado para funcionar diretamente no navegador sempre que possível, sem exigir instalação de software. Converta, comprima, gere, transforme e analise arquivos em um só lugar.

records.name: HustlrMate
records.tagline: For people serious about getting things done.
records.description: HustlrMate helps you find someone who will actually show up with you. Set your goals, find an accountability partner based on your goals, schedule and working style, & build your partnership inside a dedicated workspace for tasks, focus sessions & daily checkins. Unlike a typical productivity tracker, the goal isn't just to tell you what you planned to do. It's to connect your progress with another real person and make accountability part of the workflow.

records.name: Shadow Link
records.tagline: Uncensored, private AI workspace with real agent tooling
records.description: Shadow Link is an uncensored AI workspace where the agent runs commands, accesses remote machines, and generates images — no policy filter, no paywalls. • Uncensored agent: no banned-list, no classifier, no refusals • Real agent tooling: commands, remote shell, 256K context • Image gen: house GPU, two engines, free logo overlay • Zero-knowledge vault: ciphertext at rest, no wire recovery • Consult Mode: BYO keys — Shadow, GPT, DeepSeek • Council: parallel blind answers, agent weighs results

records.name: Cursor Glass
records.tagline: Smooth, customizable cursor zoom for live demos
records.description: Cursor Glass transforms your cursor into an ultra-smooth, high-fidelity magnifier built for live demos, video tutorials, and accessibility. Key features: • Up to 10× crystal-clear magnification with zero lag • Customizable lens shapes, borders, and sizing • Follows your cursor seamlessly or locks into focus • Lightweight macOS native performance Keep your audience focused on exactly what matters, without clunky full-screen zooming.

records.name: OpenScience
records.tagline: The open-source AI workbench for scientific research
records.description: OpenScience is an open-source AI agent for scientific research. It reads papers, writes and runs code, works in notebooks and a terminal, and sends long jobs to Modal, your own servers, or a Slurm/PBS cluster. Give it a metric and Autoresearch runs experiments, logs every one, and keeps hill-climbing. Use 30+ models through one wallet, sign in with ChatGPT, or run a local model. It ranks #1 on agentic scientific research benchmarks. Free and open source.

records.name: NeuralFlex
records.tagline: AI trading, built to be measured, not to be believed
records.description: NeuralFlex is an AI trading system for US stocks and crypto, run in public. Its live account trades virtual money on an Alpaca paper account, and anyone can watch equity, drawdown and open positions update every 30 seconds. Members see every position and time-stamped fill. The research log says how many ideas failed: 1,865 tested, none passed validation. Simulations are clearly labelled. Built to be measured, not to be believed. Not investment advice.

records.name: Lofi Cities
records.tagline: Pixel-art city nights with endless, browser-generated lofi
records.description: Pick from 11 animated pixel-art cities and listen to endless lofi composed live in your browser. Choose from 9 music styles, change the weather, and mix city sounds. Set focus or sleep timers, follow the night on a city tour, or explore the scenes on your phone. Free, no account needed, and works offline after your first visit.

records.name: Virtual Cards, Global Payments & More
records.tagline: Simplifying Payments, Cards, Transfers & Digital Finance
records.description: Issue virtual Visa & Mastercard, send money globally, collect payments, redeem gift cards, and manage subscriptions — all in one secure account.

records.name: TrendPulse
records.tagline: India-first trend briefs for creators and small teams
records.description: TrendPulse is an open-source Python CLI for Indian creators. Pick a niche for an IST-stamped Google Trends India brief, optionally add YouTube India with an API key, or watch rising public hashtags on Bluesky and Mastodon. Run it locally and configure alerts.

records.name: Fileful
records.tagline: Know what is missing before you close the month
records.description: Collect month-end documents in one clear request. Try the editable checklist free, without an account. Save private client links, item reviews and monthly repeats in a $29/month workspace after a 14-day trial. No card required; the trial ends without a charge.

records.name: Think in Numbers
records.tagline: Journals stop at feelings. Think in Numbers acts on them.
records.description: Think in Numbers is a smart journaling app with time tracking built in. Write or say your day and see where every hour went.

records.name: Handwriting Font Maker
records.tagline: Turn your handwriting into a custom TTF font for free
records.description: Turn your handwriting into a real, installable TrueType font directly in your browser. Print the template, write your characters, take a photo, and upload it. Handwriting Font Maker extracts your letters, lets you adjust and preview them, then exports your customTTF font. Everything is processed locally in your browser, so your handwriting images never leave your device. It’s completely free, with no signup or subscription required.
